_note: Every value carries its source and whether it was re-checked in that source during this project (checked=true) or is quoted from memory / a secondary summary (checked=false). Unchecked values must be confirmed against the standard and the mill certificate before any real use.

E355+SR.source: EN 10305-1 grade E355, condition +SR; values from a tube mill catalogue (Interpipe), seen only as a web-search summary

42CrMo4+QT.source: EN 10083-3, 42CrMo4 +QT, minimum Re / Rm by ruling section d (upper bound, mm) (from memory)

oil.name: HLP 46 mineral oil (ISO VG 46)
oil.source: VG 46 at 40 C by definition of the grade (ISO 3448); 100 C value, bulk modulus 1.6 GPa and expansion 7e-4 /K are typical mineral-oil values from memory; viscosity-temperature by the ASTM D341 Walther form (from memory)

weld_categories._note: EN 1993-1-9 detail category = stress range at 2e6 cycles (MPa), slope m=3 to 5e6, m=5 to 1e8, cut-off below. Assignment of the tube-to-base weld to a category is a design decision recorded in the order file; 71 assumes a full-penetration weld with the root inspected, 36 assumes a one-sided weld with an uninspected root (IIW recommendations, from memory).
weld_categories.source: EN 1993-1-9 S-N form; IIW (Hobbacher 2016) FAT values for one-sided butt welds (from memory)

fatigue_factors.source: gamma_Mf 1.35 = EN 1993-1-9 safe-life, high consequence; j=1.5 and fW=0.45, ND=1e6, k=5 = FKM guideline order of magnitude for machined steel; thread endurance VDI 2230-1 sigma_ASV = 0.85(150/d+45) MPa for threads rolled before heat treatment (all from memory)
